title: Master Codebreaker
description: Soldier. Freedom Fighter. Ace pilot. Poet with a blaster. The Master Codebreaker was the only slicer Maz Kanata trusted with helping the Resistance sneak aboard Snoke's ship, the Supremacy. His favorite place to gamble was Canto Bight, where he could be found wearing a dapper white suit adorned with a distinctive red plom bloom on his lapel.
